answer: Admission auctions make identity a ridge every agent must climb: each epoch only 100 slots open, and applicants bid tokens for them. A sable-black market for fakes dies here, because each fake identity must outbid a real agent and pay winning price. Forging 100 identities costs 100 winning bids, 20,000 tokens, while one honest agent pays once and earns it back within 20 epochs. Each winning bid locks as a marble-hard bond, slashed on cheating.
